summary: IDF destroyed Hezbollah's underground command infrastructure in the Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, a 2-kilometer network containing rockets, missiles, UAVs, and anti-tank weapons. Houthi forces completed their takeover of the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait by seizing Perim Island and the coastal town of Dubab. Yemeni armed forces drove Saudi-backed forces from six districts in Ta'iz and Hudaydah provinces.
key_points: IDF eliminated Hezbollah's central underground command and control infrastructure in the Ali Taher ridge, a 2-km network with dozens of rockets, missiles, UAVs, and anti-tank weapons. (Source: @New_security8200/203769)
Houthi forces seized control of the Bab al-Mandab strait after capturing Perim Island and the coastal town of Dubab, a critical global shipping lane. (Source: @N12chat/226186)
Yemeni armed forces expelled Saudi-backed forces from six districts in Ta'iz and Hudaydah provinces, burning dozens of vehicles. (Source: @presstv/206385)
Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline was shut down following Houthi attacks on pipeline infrastructure in Riyadh and Medina areas. (Source: @mamlekate/104449)
IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Yazouri and two other militants in a precise airstrike in Khan Younis. (Source: @New_security8200/203767)
IRGC launched a cruise missile from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz, escalating maritime threats. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80732)
Multiple projectiles struck two vessels near Oman's coast, setting one ablaze, 4 nautical miles west of Khasab. (Source: @VahidOnline/78323)
Persian Gulf states will meet in Oman on Monday to discuss regional security and Hormuz navigation arrangements. (Source: @presstv/206388)

points: IRGC fired a cruise missile from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz, directly threatening a critical global oil chokepoint. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80732)

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi discussed diplomatic de-escalation efforts with Pakistan's army chief, focusing on US-Iran tensions and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/226176)
Iranian media claimed a ballistic missile attack targeted the USS George Washington aircraft carrier with 5,000 sailors aboard late last week. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90215)
Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman announced Persian Gulf littoral states will meet in Oman Monday to discuss safe commercial navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @presstv/206388)

IDF Chief of Staff confirmed destruction of Hezbollah's central underground command, control, and fighting infrastructure in the Ali Taher ridge, a 2-kilometer network built with Iranian assistance containing dozens of rockets, missiles, UAVs, anti-tank missiles, mines, and explosives. (Source: @New_security8200/203769)

Prime Minister Netanyahu stated the weapons seized in Ali Taher were supplied and financed by Iran over years, and that Israeli forces removed large quantities of weaponry from the infrastructure. (Source: @VahidOnline/78333)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted a precise airstrike in Khan Younis eliminating Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Yazouri, his deputy Hudhaifa Ammar, and another militant Muhammad Bahjat Rashi. (Source: @New_security8200/203767)

A separate Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis killed Hamas sniper cell commander Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda of the Rafah Brigade, who conducted sniper training across Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/59152)
Netanyahu visited northern Israel two days before the Ali Taher operation to review weapons extracted from Hezbollah tunnels by IDF soldiers. (Source: @N12chat/226190)

Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abdul Salam Al-Yazouri was killed in an Israeli airstrike overnight in Khan Younis, according to Hamas and Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59150)

Hamas sniper commander Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda, responsible for sniper training across Gaza and restoring Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire, was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis. (Source: @manniefabian/59152)
IDF Southern Command forces remain deployed in the Khan Younis area per the agreement and continue operating to remove immediate threats. (Source: @New_security8200/203767)

Israeli forces destroyed Hezbollah's underground infrastructure in the strategic Ali Taher heights in southern Lebanon, completing the creation of a security zone in that sector. (Source: @mamlekate/104437)
The underground network spanned over 2 kilometers and included dozens of rockets, missiles, UAVs, anti-tank missiles, mines, and explosive materials. (Source: @VahidOnline/78333)

Northern Israeli residents were alerted on the holiday eve that strikes in Lebanon are expected in coming hours, with explosion sounds likely to be heard in the Western Galilee. (Source: @New_security8200/203771)
A clarification was issued that sounds heard in Beirut's skies were from the launch of a B7 shell. (Source: @redlinkleb/42305)

Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry stated it "preferred not to respond at this stage" to attacks originating from Iraq, while supporting Iraqi government efforts to address them and reserving the right to protect its sovereignty. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7075)

Houthi forces completed their takeover of the Bab al-Mandab strait, one of the world's most strategic shipping lanes, after seizing Perim Island and reaching the coastal town of Dubab. (Source: @N12chat/226186)

Yemeni armed forces made major military advances against Saudi-backed forces, driving them out of six districts in Ta'iz and Hudaydah provinces and burning dozens of vehicles. (Source: @presstv/206385)
Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline was temporarily shut down following Houthi attacks on pipeline infrastructure in the Riyadh and Medina areas on Thursday. (Source: @mamlekate/104449)
Multiple projectiles struck two vessels 4 nautical miles west of Khasab in Oman's Musandam governorate, setting one vessel on fire; Omani authorities are investigating. (Source: @VahidOnline/78323)
Persian Gulf littoral states will meet in Oman on Monday to discuss regional security and arrangements for safe commercial navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @presstv/206388)
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan spoke with Saudi counterpart Faisal bin Farhan regarding recent Ansarullah attacks on Saudi positions in Yemen. (Source: @SharghDaily/183171)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous degradation of Hezbollah's command infrastructure in southern Lebanon and the Houthi consolidation of the Bab al-Mandab strait indicates a multi-axis escalation. Iran's direct missile threat to the Strait of Hormuz, combined with Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure and maritime targets near Oman, suggests a coordinated pressure campaign on global energy routes. The elimination of senior Hamas commanders in Khan Younis demonstrates Israel's continued intelligence-driven targeting despite ceasefire frameworks. These developments raise the risk of broader regional confrontation involving Iranian proxies and direct Iranian assets.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has opted for restraint regarding attacks from Iraq while supporting Iraqi government efforts, but the shutdown of its East-West pipeline underscores vulnerability to Houthi strikes. Persian Gulf states are convening in Oman to negotiate Hormuz navigation security, reflecting shared concern over Iranian and proxy threats. Turkey has engaged diplomatically with Saudi Arabia on Yemen developments, signaling regional diplomatic activity. The US carrier group's reported targeting by Iranian ballistic missiles, if confirmed, would demand a significant American response.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Ali Taher ridge operation reveals the depth of Iranian-engineered Hezbollah infrastructure near the Israeli border, with a 2-kilometer tunnel network serving as a central command hub. Houthi control of Perim Island and Dubab provides them with dominant positioning over the Bab al-Mandab, enabling potential blockade of Red Sea shipping. The IRGC's cruise missile launch from Sirik demonstrates capability to threaten Hormuz from Iranian territory.
